name: Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and sale of wind power equipment in China. The company provides value-added services for wind turbines, wind farm management optimization, and personnel capacity improvement, as well as spare parts solutions, lean operation and maintenance, special operation and maintenance, intelligent equipment, intelligent asset management, asset optimization, training, and consulting. It is also involved in the wind resource development, wind farm investment and construction, wind farm operation, or transfer. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Shanghai, China.
